content.short: Onchain art project that changes every time it's refreshed.
content.description:
The Refresh, created by ThisCrazyLife, is a JavaScript based art project. It was the first fully interactive onchain art project that changes every time it's refreshed. With each refresh the design changes and moves to a different location on the canvas. The background gradients also change their angle and spread across the canvas when refreshed. Between those two changing combinations you will never come across the same image twice.

When you like one the images you'll have to save it or it will be gone forever! It was created as way to make people want to go into their wallets and play with their NFTs instead of just having static images that always look the same.

ThisCrazyLife wanted people to start having fun with the actual NFT itself and be able to interact with it.
